§6Warning: Redstone Conduits§f

§aRedstone signal management for reactor control.§f
This quest covers using §bRedstone Conduits§f to control reactor components. Redstone signals can be used to enable/disable fuel insertion, control cooling systems, and trigger emergency shutdowns.

Set up redstone conduits to automate your reactor's operation. A redstone signal can start or stop fuel feed, adjust coolant flow, or trigger emergency cooling when things get hot.

§cWARNING:§f Improper redstone wiring can cause your reactor to run uncontrolled. Test your automation thoroughly before relying on it. Meltdowns from redstone bugs are the worst kind.

§ePS:§f Redstone conduits are also useful for controlling any machine in NuclearCraft, not just reactors.
